title_zh: GPT-6 Sol 与 Luna 发布，API 价格降低 50%
content_zh:
OpenAI 9 月 22 日发布 GPT-6 Sol 与 GPT-6 Luna，将 GPT-6 Astra 在专业工作、事实准确性、编程和电脑操作方面的部分进展下放到更快、价格更低的两款模型。官方称，相比 GPT-5.6 的促销价，两款新模型的 API 价格都下调 50%。

GPT-6 Sol 每 100 万 Token 输入和输出价格分别为 2 美元和 10 美元；GPT-6 Luna 分别为 0.1 美元和 0.5 美元。OpenAI 内部测试显示，GPT-6 Sol 的事实性错误约为前代的一半；在 DeepSWE 1.1 中，Sol 的最高成绩为 68.8%，Luna 为 66.6%。

GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna 已向 Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 和 Edu 用户的 ChatGPT Work 与 Codex 开放；Free 和 Go 用户可在桌面应用使用 Luna。API 模型名分别为 `gpt-6-sol` 和 `gpt-6-luna`。
title_en: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna with 50% Price Cut
content_en:
On September 22, OpenAI unveiled GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna. These two new models bring advanced capabilities from the flagship GPT-6 Astra—specifically in professional tasks, factual accuracy, coding, and computer operations—into faster, more cost-effective packages.

Compared to the promotional pricing of GPT-5.6, API costs for both models have been slashed by 50%. GPT-6 Sol is priced at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, while the ultra-lightweight GPT-6 Luna costs just $0.1 and $0.5, respectively.

In terms of performance, OpenAI's internal testing shows that GPT-6 Sol cuts factual errors roughly in half compared to its predecessor. On the DeepSWE 1.1 benchmark, Sol achieved a top score of 68.8%, while Luna reached 66.6%.

Both models are now available to Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu subscribers via ChatGPT Work and Codex. Free and Go tier users can access Luna through desktop applications. The API identifiers are `gpt-6-sol` and `gpt-6-luna`.

title_zh: Claude Opus 5.5 发布，典型任务运行成本降低 40%
content_zh:
Anthropic 9 月 22 日发布 Claude Opus 5.5，这是 Claude 5.5 家族的首款模型。官方称，新模型在多数工作中达到 Claude Fable 5.1 的水平，常规设置下处理典型工作负载的成本比 Opus 5 低 40%，输出速度则快 30% 以上。

Opus 5.5 每 100 万 Token 的输入、输出和缓存读取价格分别为 4 美元、20 美元和 0.2 美元。在 Anthropic 披露的案例中，早期测试者用它在不到一天内完成 68 万行代码迁移；在一项网页加载优化测试中，模型在 40 次尝试中成功 39 次。

这是 Anthropic 公开呼吁「放慢前沿模型进度」后的首次发布。模型上线前接受了 Frontier Design 和 METR 等外部机构的评估，同时采用与 Claude Fable 5.1 类似的生物安全与网络安全防护。Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 Haiku 5.5 将在未来几周推出。
title_en: Anthropic Debuts Claude Opus 5.5, Slashing Costs by 40%
content_en:
Anthropic has officially launched Claude Opus 5.5, the first model in its new Claude 5.5 family. The company claims the model matches the performance of Claude Fable 5.1 across most tasks, while reducing typical workload costs by 40% and boosting output speeds by over 30% compared to Opus 5.

Pricing for Opus 5.5 is set at $4 per million input tokens, $20 per million output tokens, and $0.2 per million cache reads. Early testing showcased its efficiency, with one partner migrating 680,000 lines of code in less than a day, and another achieving a 39-out-of-40 success rate in web-loading optimization tests.

This release marks Anthropic's first launch since publicly advocating for a slower pace in frontier model development. Prior to deployment, Opus 5.5 underwent rigorous external evaluations by organizations like Frontier Design and METR, and it incorporates robust biosecurity and cybersecurity safeguards. Anthropic plans to roll out Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 in the coming weeks.

title_zh: 特努斯：Siri AI 不应代替人际关系
content_zh:
苹果 CEO John Ternus 在接受 Canal+ 节目 Clique 采访时表示，Siri AI 「并非被设计成你的朋友」。面对 AI 伴侣产品的市场竞争，他认为苹果不希望 AI 取代人与人的关系，因为人际关系是学习、成长和获得快乐的基础。

他还谈到 iPhone Duo 的开发取舍。苹果从类似 iPad 的大屏体验出发确定展开比例，没有沿用常见的两块手机屏幕拼接形态。铰链和屏幕的可靠性是主要工程问题；例如，团队需要同时处理展开角度、屏幕连续性与软件动画的配合。

Ternus 特别展示了展开手机时跨越两侧屏幕的动画。他把这个小细节视为工程之外的产品目标：用户在展开设备时能立刻理解界面如何连续，同时保留一点轻松感。

对于接任 CEO 后的方向，Ternus 称不会对苹果做激进改造。Tim Cook 和苹果董事会询问他是否愿意接任时，他形容自己「幸好当时是坐着的」。他给出的经营边界是继续把产品、创新和用户放在中心，不把新任期包装成路线翻转。
title_en: Apple’s John Ternus: Siri AI Should Not Replace Human Relationships
content_en:
In a recent interview with Canal+ show *Clique*, Apple's John Ternus emphasized that Siri AI "is not designed to be your friend." Addressing the rising trend of AI companions, Ternus stated that Apple has no desire to replace human-to-human connections, which he believes are the foundation of learning, growth, and happiness.

Ternus also shared insights into the development of the "iPhone Duo." Rather than fusing two standard phone screens together, Apple designed the foldable device from the ground up to offer an iPad-like large-screen experience. He noted that hinge and screen reliability were major engineering hurdles, requiring the team to seamlessly coordinate unfolding angles, display continuity, and software animations.

To illustrate this, Ternus highlighted a subtle animation that spans both screens when the device unfolds. He described this detail as a key product goal beyond pure engineering, designed to help users instantly grasp the continuity of the interface while adding a touch of delight.

Addressing his transition to the CEO role, Ternus stated he does not plan to radically overhaul Apple. Recalling the moment Tim Cook and the board asked him to step up, Ternus joked that he was "thankfully sitting down." He defined his leadership boundary as keeping products, innovation, and users at the core, rather than framing his tenure as a dramatic shift in direction.

title_zh: OPPO Find X10 系列发布：4999 元起，标准版配备双 2 亿像素镜头
content_zh:
OPPO 昨晚发布 Find X10 Pro Max、Find X10 和 Find X10 E 三款手机，同场还推出 Watch S2、Enco X4 耳机和 AI 心力球等新品。三款手机均将于 9 月 24 日 10:00 开售。

其他新品中，Watch S2 售价 1599 元起，Enco X4 售价 1199 元；重 9.8 克的 OPPO AI 心力球主打全天事件记录与任务跟踪，先行者体验价 499 元，10 月 15 日开放购买体验。

🔗 相关阅读：OPPO 新旗舰塞满了「两亿」，却只要 6799 元起
title_en: OPPO Launches Find X10 Series Starting at 4,999 Yuan, Featuring Dual 200MP Cameras
content_en:
OPPO has officially unveiled its latest flagship smartphone lineup, the Find X10 series, which includes the Find X10 Pro Max, Find X10, and Find X10 E. The series starts at 4,999 RMB, with the standard model boasting an impressive dual 200-megapixel camera setup. All three smartphones are scheduled to go on sale on September 24 at 10:00 AM.

Alongside the smartphones, OPPO introduced several ecosystem products. These include the Watch S2 (starting at 1,599 RMB) and the Enco X4 earbuds (priced at 1,199 RMB).

Additionally, the company debuted the OPPO AI Heart Ball, a lightweight 9.8-gram wearable designed for all-day event logging and task tracking. It is priced at an early-bird rate of 499 RMB and will be available for purchase starting October 15.

title_zh: 第六代骁龙 8 双旗舰发布，iQOO 16、红魔 12 Pro+ 首批搭载
content_zh:
高通发布第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版和第六代骁龙 8 至尊版两款旗舰移动平台，重点升级终端侧 AI、游戏和影像能力。

其中超级至尊版的 Oryon CPU 峰值频率达到 5GHz，并加入面向 AI 负载的新 GPU、NPU 架构。

小米、vivo、OPPO、荣耀、红魔等品牌将率先采用，iQOO 16、iQOO Pad Ultra 和红魔 12 Pro+ 已确认搭载超级至尊版。

同期，高通还联合阶跃、无量火和江波龙，将阶跃 StepEdge-Omni 30B-MoE 模型完整部署在第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版手机平台上。

优化后模型运行内存需求降低超过 50%，预填充吞吐超过 330 Token/s、解码超过 28 Token/s，可在本地完成邮件理解、行程规划、日历同步等智能体任务，无需调用云端。
title_en: Qualcomm Unveils 6th Gen Snapdragon 8 Flagship Chips; iQOO 16 and RedMagic 12 Pro+ Among First to Adopt
content_en:
Qualcomm has officially launched its next-generation flagship mobile platforms: the 6th Gen Snapdragon 8 Extreme Edition and the 6th Gen Snapdragon 8 Elite. The new processors bring significant upgrades to on-device AI, gaming performance, and imaging capabilities. Notably, the Extreme Edition features an Oryon CPU with a peak frequency of 5GHz, alongside newly architected GPU and NPU units optimized for AI workloads.

Leading smartphone brands, including Xiaomi, vivo, OPPO, Honor, and RedMagic, are set to adopt the new chips. Devices such as the iQOO 16, iQOO Pad Ultra, and RedMagic 12 Pro+ have been confirmed to feature the high-end Extreme Edition.

In collaboration with StepFun, Wulianghuo, and Longsys, Qualcomm has also successfully deployed the StepEdge-Omni 30B-MoE model locally on the new platform. This optimization reduces RAM requirements by over 50% while achieving a prefill throughput of over 330 tokens per second and decoding speeds exceeding 28 tokens per second. This allows users to run complex AI agent tasks—such as email comprehension, itinerary planning, and calendar synchronization—entirely on-device without relying on the cloud.

title_zh: Qwen Intelligence 亮相，荣耀 Magic9 系列、Robot Phone 首批搭载
content_zh:
荣耀与阿里巴巴在 9 月 22 日的云栖大会上宣布，将以 Qwen Intelligence 和 MagicOS 为基础，共同打造五个面向下一代 AI 手机的垂直领域模型与解决方案。

将于 9 月 28 日发布的荣耀 Magic9 系列，以及荣耀 Robot Phone，将成为首批搭载这套手机 AI 解决方案的正式机型。新闻稿称，这套方案采用系统级 Agent Harness 架构，包括端侧全模态、VLM、GUI Agent、Agentic Fast 和 Agentic Pro 等组件。

荣耀与阿里巴巴给出的测试数据显示，该方案的综合任务准确率为 91.8%，GUI 操作速度为 3.6 秒，可执行超过 100 步的复杂长程任务，端到端服务闭环率超过 90%。
title_en: Honor and Alibaba Unveil Qwen Intelligence AI Solution for Magic9 Series and Robot Phone
content_en:
At the Apsara Conference, Honor and Alibaba announced a strategic partnership to co-develop five vertical AI models and solutions for next-generation AI smartphones, built upon Qwen Intelligence and MagicOS.

The upcoming Honor Magic9 series, set to launch on September 28, and the Honor Robot Phone will be the first devices to feature this new AI solution. The system utilizes a system-level "Agent Harness" architecture, incorporating advanced components such as on-device multimodal processing, Vision Language Models (VLM), GUI Agents, Agentic Fast, and Agentic Pro.

According to test data released by the two companies, the solution achieves a 91.8% task accuracy rate and a GUI operation speed of 3.6 seconds. It is capable of executing complex, long-range tasks exceeding 100 steps, with an end-to-end service completion rate of over 90%.

title_zh: 比亚迪西安基地扩招超 8000 人，最高月薪 1 万元
content_zh:
近日，西安市人力资源和社会保障局、西安市高新区人力资源行业协会等平台发布比亚迪西安基地招聘信息。高新、草堂、集贤和西咸多个厂区合计释放超过 8000 个岗位，主要面向焊装、涂装、总装、冲压、质检和设备维护等一线工种。

普通操作工综合月薪为 5500 至 8000 元，部分技术岗位最高月薪为 1 万元，入职奖励最高 6000 元。西安基地上半年经历产线切换与排产下调，本轮招聘与下半年产能恢复、出口订单增长同时发生。
title_en: BYD's Xi'an Base Launches Massive Recruitment Drive for Over 8,000 Workers
content_en:
BYD's Xi'an production base has launched a massive recruitment campaign, offering more than 8,000 frontline positions across multiple plants, including Gaoxin, Caotang, Jixian, and Xixian. The hiring drive targets roles in welding, painting, final assembly, stamping, quality inspection, and equipment maintenance.

General operators can expect a monthly salary ranging from 5,500 to 8,000 RMB, while specialized technical roles offer up to 10,000 RMB per month. Additionally, new hires are eligible for sign-on bonuses of up to 6,000 RMB.

This recruitment surge follows a period of production line transitions and output adjustments in the first half of the year. The hiring wave coincides with a recovery in production capacity and a surge in export orders for the second half of the year.

title_zh: Meta Muse 登顶美国应用榜，Mac 版同时被曝授权漏洞
content_zh:
Meta 9 月 8 日推出个人 AI Agent Muse，可代用户处理邮件、预约、购物和长期计划。9 月 22 日披露的 Sensor Tower 数据显示，Muse 上线 13 天下载量超过 250 万次，并登顶美国 App Store 免费应用榜。

产品热度与分析师上调目标价共同推动 Meta 股价 9 月 21 日上涨 11.43%。《福布斯》估算，马克·扎克伯格的个人财富单日增加 250 亿美元，达到 2536 亿美元。

与此同时，安全研究员 Patrick Wardle 发现 Muse 的 macOS 客户端存在本地权限漏洞：任意已在 Mac 上运行的应用或终端命令，都可改写一个未公开的听写服务地址，从而截取 Muse 账户的授权 token。攻击者必须先获得本地代码执行能力，纯远程请求无法直接触发漏洞；一旦拿到 token，便可能借用 Muse 的高权限操作文件或调用摄像头。
title_en: Meta's Muse Tops US App Charts as macOS Security Flaw Surfaces
content_en:
Meta's new personal AI agent, Muse, has topped the US App Store's free charts, securing over 2.5 million downloads within 13 days of its September 8 launch. Designed to assist users with emails, scheduling, shopping, and long-term planning, the app's rapid adoption—alongside positive analyst outlooks—fueled an 11.43% surge in Meta's stock on September 21. This rally boosted CEO Mark Zuckerberg's net worth by $25 billion in a single day, bringing his total fortune to $253.6 billion.

However, the app's success has been overshadowed by a security concern. Security researcher Patrick Wardle discovered a local privilege escalation vulnerability in Muse's macOS client. The flaw allows any local application or terminal command to rewrite an undisclosed dictation service address, enabling attackers to intercept Muse's authorization tokens.

While the exploit requires prior local code execution and cannot be triggered purely remotely, obtaining the token would grant attackers Muse's elevated permissions, potentially allowing them to manipulate files or access the Mac's camera.

title_zh: 美国联邦航空管理局开始用 AI 调度航班
content_zh:
美国联邦航空管理局已开始使用名为 SMART 的空中交通管理平台，将天气、航路、实时流量和管制员排班等 200 条数据流统一到一套界面中，用 AI 辅助生成容量、拥堵与航班排程建议。

美国交通部称，这套系统的目标是减少现有多个独立工具之间的信息断层，使管制人员在全国空域发生天气或通信故障时更快重新安排流量。平台提供建议，运行决策仍由空中交通管制人员作出。
title_en: FAA Deploys AI-Powered "SMART" Platform to Streamline Air Traffic Management
content_en:
The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has begun utilizing an AI-powered air traffic management platform called SMART. The system consolidates over 200 data streams—including weather, flight routes, real-time traffic, and controller schedules—into a single interface to generate AI-assisted recommendations for capacity, congestion, and flight scheduling.

According to the U.S. Department of Transportation, the platform aims to bridge information gaps between previously fragmented tools. This integration will enable controllers to reroute traffic much faster during severe weather or communication outages.

While the SMART platform provides data-driven recommendations, the FAA emphasized that final operational decisions will remain entirely in the hands of human air traffic controllers.

title_zh: 赛力斯回应与华为合作生变：问界转向专属专营
content_zh:
赛力斯董事长张兴海 9 月 22 日在半年度业绩会上回应与华为合作模式变化称，双方合作已进一步升级为问界专属专营模式。

张兴海表示，新模式将通过专属渠道、专属服务团队和专属品牌运营集中资源，提高渠道效率。赛力斯将这次调整称为现有合作基础上的体系与协同机制升级，并否认合作关系生变。
title_en: Seres Denies Huawei Rift, Upgrades Aito Partnership to Exclusive Model
content_en:
Seres Chairman Zhang Xinghai has dismissed rumors of a strained partnership with Huawei, clarifying that their collaboration has instead upgraded to an exclusive dealership and operation model for the Aito brand. Speaking at a semi-annual earnings meeting on September 22, Zhang emphasized that the relationship remains strong.

Under the new model, the two companies will consolidate resources through dedicated sales channels, specialized service teams, and exclusive brand operations. This strategic shift aims to significantly boost channel efficiency and streamline customer experience, representing a systematic upgrade of their existing cooperative framework.

title_zh: 前小米 XLA 负责人陈龙创业，研发「自进化」具身大模型
content_zh:
《21 汽车·一见 Auto》从多个独立信源获悉，前小米汽车智驾基座模型兼 XLA 大模型负责人陈龙已前往硅谷创业，与前 Google DeepMind 科学家共同研发具身大模型。该项目已获得融资，并开始商业化合作；公司名称和融资规模尚未公开。

陈龙在小米主导 Xiaomi MiMo-Embodied 和 XLA 大模型，后者已推送至 2026 款 SU7 和 YU7。在离职前，他将 XLA 交给小米汽车端到端负责人陈光继续迭代。

新项目暂时不做机器人本体，而是尝试把递归式自我改进用到具身大模型：用较少数据让系统在任务、测试和反馈循环中改进。这条路线还要解决仿真环境过拟合、虚实迁移和物理任务成功标准不稳定等问题。
title_en: Former Xiaomi Autonomous Driving Lead Launches Embodied AI Startup in Silicon Valley
content_en:
Chen Long, the former head of Xiaomi's smart driving foundation model and XLA large model, has relocated to Silicon Valley to launch a new startup. Partnering with a former Google DeepMind scientist, the venture focuses on developing "self-evolving" embodied AI models. The startup has already secured funding and initiated commercial partnerships, though its name and funding details remain undisclosed.

During his tenure at Xiaomi, Chen led the development of the Xiaomi MiMo-Embodied and XLA models, the latter of which has been deployed in the upcoming 2026 SU7 and YU7 vehicle models. Following his departure, the XLA project was handed over to Chen Guang, Xiaomi's head of end-to-end autonomous driving.

Rather than building physical robots, the new startup aims to apply recursive self-improvement techniques to embodied AI. This approach allows the system to learn and improve through task-feedback loops using minimal data, though the team must still overcome challenges such as simulation overfitting, sim-to-real transfer, and unstable physical task evaluation standards.

title_zh: DeepSeek、月之暗面获邀向联合国安理会介绍 AI 风险
content_zh:
据路透社报道，DeepSeek 与月之暗面已获邀在联合国安理会关于 AI 与国际安全的会议上发言。会议定于当地时间 9 月 23 日举行，OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 计划出席，外交官也预计 Anthropic 高级代表将参与。

消息人士称，DeepSeek 创始人梁文锋不计划亲自参加，最终安排仍可能调整。DeepSeek 与月之暗面尚未回应置评请求。

这是联合国安理会继 2023 年后再次集中讨论 AI 风险。此次会议将涉及递归式自我改进、跨境事故通报和前沿模型安全标准等议题，美中官员也已同意继续就 AI 安全展开对话。
title_en: Chinese AI Startups DeepSeek and Moonshot AI Invited to Brief UN Security Council on AI Risks
content_en:
Prominent Chinese artificial intelligence startups DeepSeek and Moonshot AI have been invited to brief the United Nations Security Council on AI risks and international security. The high-profile meeting, scheduled for September 23, will also feature OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and senior representatives from Anthropic.

While DeepSeek founder Liang Wenfeng is reportedly not planning to attend in person, the final attendee list remains subject to change. Neither DeepSeek nor Moonshot AI has officially commented on the invitation.

This meeting marks the UN Security Council's second major discussion on AI risks since 2023. Key agenda items include recursive self-improvement, cross-border incident reporting, and safety standards for frontier models, reflecting ongoing bilateral dialogues between US and Chinese officials regarding AI safety.

title_zh: 英国消费者机构呼吁基础服务保留人工客服
content_zh:
据《卫报》报道，英国消费者协会 Citizens Advice 呼吁能源、银行、电信和互联网等基础服务提供商减少对 AI 聊天机器人的依赖，并向用户提供转接人工客服的清晰通道。

该机构认为，对账单、账户冻结、连接中断等需要查询个人状况的问题，循环式机器人对话容易拉长解决时间；数字技能不足、没有稳定网络或有可访问性需求的人群，也可能因「自助优先」的服务设计被排除。

Citizens Advice 的调查显示，超过半数受访者在使用机器人客服时遇到时间浪费、压力增加或问题解决被延误。该机构提出的「与人交谈的权利」保留自助工具，同时要求企业在机器人无法解决问题时，允许用户迅速转入人工处理。
title_en: UK Consumer Watchdog Demands "Right to Speak to a Person" Over AI Chatbots
content_en:
UK consumer advocacy group Citizens Advice is calling on essential service providers—including energy, banking, telecom, and internet companies—to reduce their reliance on AI chatbots and ensure customers have a clear, direct path to human support.

According to the watchdog, looping chatbot interactions often delay resolutions for complex personal issues such as billing discrepancies, frozen accounts, and service outages. Furthermore, "self-service first" designs risk excluding vulnerable populations, including those with limited digital skills, unreliable internet access, or specific accessibility needs.

A survey by Citizens Advice revealed that over half of the respondents experienced wasted time, increased stress, or delayed issue resolution when dealing with automated customer service. While not opposing self-service tools entirely, the group is advocating for a "right to speak to a person," requiring companies to offer a seamless and rapid transfer to human agents when AI fails to resolve an issue.

title_zh: oMLX 作者 Jun Kim 加入 Hugging Face，项目转为全职维护
content_zh:
Hugging Face 9 月 22 日宣布，oMLX 作者与维护者 Jun Kim 已加入公司，将继续负责这一面向苹果 MLX 生态的开源项目。oMLX 会从侧项目转为获得资金支持的全职工作，仍采用 Apache 2.0 许可证，Jun Kim 继续担任项目负责人。

Hugging Face 表示，oMLX 将作为新想法的试验场，同时继续依托 `mlx-lm` 与 `mlx-vlm` 等底层库。其中一个重点是缩短 Transformers 模型定义转成 MLX 参考实现的路径，让不同推理引擎更快适配新模型，并在合适时将成果回馈至上游项目。
title_en: Hugging Face Hires oMLX Creator Jun Kim to Maintain Apple MLX Project Full-Time
content_en:
Hugging Face has announced that Jun Kim, the creator and maintainer of oMLX—an open-source project designed for Apple's MLX machine learning ecosystem—has joined the company. With this move, oMLX transitions from a side project to a fully funded, full-time initiative. The project will remain open-source under the Apache 2.0 license, with Kim continuing to lead its development.

According to Hugging Face, oMLX will serve as an experimental playground for new ideas while continuing to build upon underlying libraries like `mlx-lm` and `mlx-vlm`.

A primary objective of the project moving forward is to streamline the conversion of Transformers model definitions into MLX reference implementations. This will enable various inference engines to adapt to new models more quickly, with plans to contribute successful optimizations back to upstream projects.

title_zh: 💡 吴泳铭：机器思考总量将达到人类的 1000 倍以上
content_zh:
阿里巴巴 CEO 吴泳铭在 2026 云栖大会的主旨演讲中表示，机器正在成为思考的主力，未来机器思考总量将达到人类的 1000 倍以上。他把这一转变与工业革命将动力变成可规模化商品类比，并把它放在 AI 行业的供给变化中理解：专业思考将从稀缺资源变成可大规模供给的能力。

他给出的两个判断是：机器将承担绝大部分思考工作，而「机器智能时代」的代表性产品尚未出现。他以罕见病研究为例，认为大量 Agent 可以绕过人类专家数量和商业回报的限制，持续完成研究、模拟和验证。

在他的框架中，当前的 AI Coding 更像电气时代早期的电灯：它首先替代现有工作，但不会直接定义下一代产品。他认为，前提是先建好模型、芯片和 AI 云三层基础设施，再等待新形态从大规模智力供给中出现。

吴泳铭据此把阿里的投入方向分为模型、芯片和 AI 云三层：模型负责生产智力，芯片与超大规模集群承接训练和推理，云平台再把这些能力提供给企业和开发者。这套方案对应的是他对「机器思考总量」的判断，不是对单一应用的预测。
title_en: Alibaba CEO Wu Yongming: Machine Thinking Will Exceed Human Thinking by Over 1,000 Times
content_en:
During his keynote speech at the Apsara Conference, Alibaba CEO Wu Yongming stated that machines are becoming the primary drivers of cognitive processing, predicting that the total volume of "machine thinking" will eventually exceed that of humans by more than 1,000 times. He likened this shift to the Industrial Revolution, which transformed physical power into a scalable commodity, noting that professional expertise will transition from a scarce resource to a mass-produced capability.

Wu shared two core insights: first, machines will soon handle the vast majority of cognitive tasks; second, the defining products of this "machine intelligence era" have yet to emerge. Using rare disease research as an example, he explained how AI agents could bypass the limitations of human expert availability and commercial viability to conduct continuous research, simulation, and validation.

In Wu's view, current applications like AI coding are akin to early electric lightbulbs in the electrical age—they replace existing labor but do not directly define next-generation products. He emphasized that the industry must first establish a robust three-tier infrastructure consisting of models, chips, and AI cloud computing before revolutionary new product forms can emerge from this abundance of machine intelligence. Consequently, Alibaba is focusing its investments across these three layers to systematically support this massive scale of machine computation.

title_zh: 阿里发布真武 V900，计划训练 5 万亿至 10 万亿参数模型
content_zh: 9 月 22 日，阿里巴巴在云栖大会上公布下一阶段 AI 基础设施路线，同时更新模型、芯片和云计算布局。
title_en: Alibaba Unveils Zhenwu V900 Chip, Targeting Models with Up to 10 Trillion Parameters
content_en:
At its annual Apsara Conference on September 22, Alibaba Group announced its next-generation AI infrastructure roadmap, alongside major updates to its proprietary models, chips, and cloud computing ecosystem.

As part of this expansion, Alibaba unveiled the Zhenwu V900 chip. The tech giant plans to leverage this new hardware to train massive AI models featuring 5 trillion to 10 trillion parameters, significantly pushing the boundaries of its current AI capabilities.

title_zh: 腾讯发布 Hy Image 3.5 preview，单次最多上传 5 张参考图
content_zh:
腾讯混元 9 月 22 日发布 Hy Image 3.5 preview，新模型支持文生图、图生图和多轮对话编辑，单次最多上传 5 张参考图，输出分辨率最高为 2K。

腾讯称，其在数百名专业设计师参与的盲测中，综合胜率比 Hy Image 3.0 高 30%。该模型已接入元宝、ima、WorkRally、OnSolo、Miora 和 WorkBuddy 等产品，同时开放腾讯云 API；2K 图像定价为每张 0.15 元，只对输出图片收费。

在元宝两个月的灰度测试期间，生图请求量提升超过 50%。新版把人像编辑、信息图、商业海报、剧集分镜和电商物料纳入同一套连续创作流程。
title_en: Tencent Launches Hy Image 3.5 Preview with Multi-Image Reference and 2K Output
content_en:
Tencent Hunyuan has officially released the preview version of Hy Image 3.5. The upgraded text-to-image model supports text-to-image generation, image-to-image synthesis, and multi-turn conversational editing. Notably, users can now upload up to five reference images simultaneously, with the system supporting output resolutions of up to 2K.

According to Tencent, blind tests involving hundreds of professional designers showed that Hy Image 3.5 outperformed its predecessor, Hy Image 3.0, by 30% in overall satisfaction. During a two-month beta test on Tencent's Yuanbao app, image generation requests surged by over 50%. The new version unifies portrait editing, infographics, commercial posters, storyboards, and e-commerce assets into a single, seamless creative workflow.

The model has already been integrated into several Tencent products, including Yuanbao, ima, WorkRally, OnSolo, Miora, and WorkBuddy, and is available via Tencent Cloud API. Pricing for 2K image generation is set at RMB 0.15 per image, with charges applied only to successful outputs.

title_zh: Googlebook 开始预售：Android 与 ChromeOS 合体，899 美元起
content_zh:
Google 9 月 21 日公布首批 Googlebook 的完整配置和发售信息。这套新平台把 Android 的应用生态、跨设备能力与 ChromeOS 的桌面浏览器、多窗口和 Linux 环境整合到 Googlebook OS，首批硬件由 Acer、ASUS、Dell、HP 和 Lenovo 推出。

系统登录后可同步 Android 手机的密码、Wi-Fi、消息和文件，并可在电脑上调用手机应用。Gemini 能力包括通过晃动光标唤起的 Magic Pointer、语音整理和自然语言生成桌面小组件；开发者还可在隔离的 Linux 环境中运行 Claude Code、Codex 和 Google 的 Antigravity。

首批五款设备全部配备至少 16GB 内存和触摸屏，采用 Intel Core Ultra 或 Snapdragon X Elite 芯片，起售价为 899 美元。美国将于 10 月 4 日开售，英国、爱尔兰、法国、德国和澳大利亚于次日发售；MediaTek 也已宣布为后续 Lenovo Googlebook 提供 3nm Dimensity CX C10 Max 芯片。
title_en: Google Announces Googlebook: Hybrid Android-ChromeOS Laptops Starting at $899
content_en:
Google has officially unveiled the specifications and release details for its highly anticipated "Googlebook" lineup. Running on the new Googlebook OS, the platform merges the vast Android app ecosystem and cross-device capabilities with ChromeOS's desktop-class browser, multi-window multitasking, and Linux environment. The initial hardware lineup will be manufactured by Acer, ASUS, Dell, HP, and Lenovo.

The operating system offers seamless integration with Android devices, allowing users to sync passwords, Wi-Fi networks, messages, and files instantly upon login, as well as run mobile apps directly on the laptop. It also features built-in Gemini AI capabilities, including "Magic Pointer" (activated by shaking the cursor), voice-based organization, and natural language generation for desktop widgets. For developers, the OS supports running Claude Code, Codex, and Google's Antigravity within isolated Linux environments.

The first five Googlebook models will all feature at least 16GB of RAM, touchscreens, and processors ranging from Intel Core Ultra to Snapdragon X Elite, with prices starting at $899. Sales will begin in the United States on October 4, followed by the UK, Ireland, France, Germany, and Australia on October 5. Additionally, MediaTek has announced that its upcoming 3nm Dimensity CX C10 Max chip will power future Lenovo Googlebook models.

title_zh: Hyper3D 上线 Agentic Mode，让 Agent 规划和修改 3D 模型
content_zh:
3D 生成工具 Hyper3D 9 月 22 日上线 Agentic Mode，把多模态输入理解、建模路径规划、模型生成和后续加工放到同一个创作流程中。

系统可从多视图、工程图和图文混合素材中识别生成主体，再按任务选择参数化建模或 Hyper3D Rodin 的原生 3D 生成路径。初版结果生成后，用户可继续用自然语言调整局部尺寸、材质、动画和模型分件。

Hyper3D 之前已开放 MCP 接口，供通用模型调用专业 3D 能力。Agentic Mode 进一步把输入整理、建模决策、检查和修改收进同一个工作台，目标是让外部 Agent 也能完成连续的 3D 创作任务。
title_en: Hyper3D Launches "Agentic Mode" to Enable AI-Driven 3D Modeling and Editing
content_en:
3D generation tool Hyper3D launched its "Agentic Mode" on September 22, integrating multimodal input understanding, modeling path planning, model generation, and post-processing into a unified workflow.

The system can identify target subjects from multi-view images, engineering drawings, and mixed text-and-image materials. It then selects either parametric modeling or Hyper3D Rodin's native 3D generation path based on the task. Once the initial draft is generated, users can use natural language to adjust local dimensions, materials, animations, and model components.

Previously, Hyper3D opened its Model Context Protocol (MCP) interface to allow general AI models to access professional 3D capabilities. The new Agentic Mode further consolidates input organization, modeling decisions, inspection, and modification into a single workbench, aiming to enable external AI agents to perform continuous 3D creation tasks.

title_zh: Seedance 2.5 上线 Draft 模式，先用 480P 试片再生成 1080P
content_zh:
火山引擎 9 月 22 日为 Seedance 2.5 API 推出 Draft（样片）模式。企业和创作者可先生成 480P 样片，确认构图、动作、对白、运镜和节奏，再通过样片 ID 发起 1080P 成片生成。

正式成片会复用样片的提示词、参考素材、随机种子、宽高比和时长等参数，尽量保持镜头结构与运动方向一致。低分辨率样片不会直接超分成片；系统会按相同生成条件再次推理，局部纹理、小字和高密度人群等细节仍可能变化。

以 5 秒 1080P 视频、抽取 4 次样片为例，官方称 Draft 模式可节约 57% 成本，生成速度提高近一倍；当样片筛选达到 20 选 1 时，成本可降低 77%。企业用户可在 API 中将 `draft` 参数设为 `true`，即梦用户也可直接选择「Seedance 2.5（样片模式）」。
title_en: Volcengine's Seedance 2.5 Introduces "Draft Mode" to Cut Video Generation Costs
content_en:
Volcengine launched "Draft Mode" for its Seedance 2.5 API on September 22. This feature allows enterprises and creators to generate low-cost 480p draft videos first to verify composition, motion, dialogue, camera work, and pacing, before initiating the final 1080p generation using the draft's ID.

The final high-resolution video reuses the draft's parameters—including prompts, reference materials, random seeds, aspect ratio, and duration—to maintain consistent camera structure and movement. Instead of directly upscaling the low-resolution draft, the system re-runs inference under the same conditions, meaning fine details like textures, small text, and dense crowds may still vary.

According to official data, using Draft Mode to generate a 5-second 1080p video after four draft trials can reduce costs by 57% and nearly double the generation speed. When the selection ratio reaches 1-in-20, costs can be slashed by up to 77%. Enterprise users can enable this by setting the `draft` parameter to `true` in the API, while users of the Jimeng platform can directly select "Seedance 2.5 (Draft Mode)."

title_zh: 东风日产新 N7 上市，限时权益价 10.99 万元起
content_zh:
东风日产 9 月 22 日发布新 N7 纯电轿车，6 个版本的官方指导价为 11.99 万至 14.99 万元，限时权益价为 10.99 万至 14.69 万元。Max 版和黑骑士版提供激光雷达，并采用与 Momenta 联合定制的辅助驾驶方案。

新车尺寸为 4930×1895×1492mm，轴距 2915mm；座舱搭载高通 8295P 芯片，支持 HiCar、Carlink 和 CarPlay。座椅系统配备 12 个按摩气囊，后排新增通风、加热和控制屏。

东风日产称，基于 Momenta R7 世界模型的辅助驾驶升级最快将在年底通过 OTA 推送。首任非营运车主可获得三电终身质保，以及两年或 6 万公里轮胎质保。
title_en: Dongfeng Nissan Launches New N7 EV, Starting at Promotional Price of 109,900 RMB
content_en:
Dongfeng Nissan officially launched its new N7 all-electric sedan on September 22. Offering six different variants, the vehicle has an official guide price ranging from 119,900 to 149,900 RMB, with a limited-time promotional starting price of 109,900 RMB (up to 146,900 RMB). The high-end Max and Black Knight editions come equipped with LiDAR and an advanced driver-assistance system (ADAS) co-developed with Momenta.

Measuring 4,930 mm in length, 1,895 mm in width, and 1,492 mm in height with a 2,915 mm wheelbase, the N7 features a smart cockpit powered by the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8295P chip. It supports multiple connectivity options, including Huawei HiCar, Carlink, and Apple CarPlay. For comfort, the seating system includes 12 massage airbags, while the rear seats have been upgraded with ventilation, heating, and dedicated control screens.

Dongfeng Nissan announced that an ADAS upgrade based on the Momenta R7 world model is expected to be pushed via over-the-air (OTA) updates as early as the end of this year. Additionally, first-time, non-commercial owners will receive a lifetime warranty on the electric drive system (battery, motor, and electronic control), alongside a two-year or 60,000-kilometer tire warranty.

title_zh: 广汽传祺越 7 上市，权益价 16.18 万元起
content_zh:
广汽传祺 9 月 22 日发布首款硬派越野 SUV 越 7，共 4 个版本，指导价为 16.98 万至 21.58 万元，上市权益价为 16.18 万至 20.78 万元。

新车搭载 1.5T 插混系统，两驱和四驱版本可选，系统综合最大功率为 400kW，百公里加速 4.2 秒。28.3kWh 和 45.975kWh 两种电池分别对应 116km 和 188km 的 CLTC 纯电续航。

越 7 全系标配前后牙嵌式机械差速锁和中央能量锁，高配空气悬架版本的最小离地间隙可在 180 至 270mm 之间调节。座舱和辅助驾驶采用高通 QCM8838 芯片，车顶配有激光雷达。
title_en: GAC Trumpchi Launches Yue 7 Rugged Off-Road SUV, Starting at 161,800 Yuan
content_en:
GAC Trumpchi officially launched its first rugged off-road SUV, the Yue 7, on September 22. Available in four variants, the vehicle features an official guide price ranging from 169,800 to 215,800 yuan, with a promotional launch price starting at 161,800 yuan.

The Yue 7 is powered by a 1.5T plug-in hybrid (PHEV) system, offering both two-wheel and four-wheel drive options. The system delivers a combined maximum output of 400 kW, enabling a 0-100 km/h acceleration time of just 4.2 seconds. Buyers can choose between 28.3 kWh and 45.975 kWh battery packs, which provide CLTC pure electric ranges of 116 km and 188 km, respectively.

Designed for serious off-roading, the SUV comes standard with front and rear mechanical differential locks alongside a central energy lock. The high-end variant features an adjustable air suspension system, allowing ground clearance to vary between 180 mm and 270 mm. Inside, the vehicle is powered by the Qualcomm QCM8838 chip for its smart cockpit and driver-assistance systems, complemented by a roof-mounted LiDAR.

title_zh: Beats 360 发布：可更换耳垫与头带垫，售价 350 美元
content_zh:
苹果旗下 Beats 发布头戴式耳机 Beats 360，售价 350 美元。新机采用可拆卸耳垫和头带垫，支持 250 多种颜色组合；标配适合运动的 Performance Knit 织物材质，另有更适合长时间佩戴的 UltraPlush 耳垫，单独售价 50 美元。

Beats 360 支持 IPX4 防汗防水、主动降噪和通透模式，开启主动降噪或 Adaptive EQ 时续航最长 32 小时。其采用 Beats 第四代自研芯片，在苹果设备上支持自动切换、查找和个性化空间音频，同时支持 Android 快速配对与 Find Hub。耳机没有佩戴检测，也不支持有线听音或 USB-C 无损音频。
title_en: Apple's Beats Debuts $350 Beats 360 Headphones with Customizable Cushions
content_en:
Apple's Beats brand has unveiled the Beats 360, a new pair of over-ear headphones priced at $350. The standout feature of the headphones is their detachable ear cushions and headband pads, which allow users to customize their look with over 250 color combinations. The headphones come standard with sport-friendly Performance Knit fabric, while premium UltraPlush cushions designed for extended wear are sold separately for $50.

The Beats 360 is equipped with IPX4 sweat and water resistance, Active Noise Cancellation (ANC), and Transparency mode. Powered by Beats' fourth-generation proprietary chip, the headphones offer up to 32 hours of battery life with ANC or Adaptive EQ enabled.

In terms of connectivity, the device supports seamless integration with Apple devices—including automatic switching, Find My, and personalized spatial audio—as well as Android Fast Pair and Find Hub. However, the headphones lack wear detection and do not support wired listening or USB-C lossless audio.

title_zh: Adobe Premiere 正式登陆 Android
content_zh:
Adobe 9 月 22 日宣布 Premiere 移动版已在 Android 上线，基础剪辑功能免费，界面无广告与导出水印。应用支持多轨时间线、逐帧精确剪辑、一键增强语音和最高 4K 导出，也可调用 Firefly 的生成式填充、图像转视频和音效生成功能。额外的生成积分与云存储需要付费。

当前版本要求 Android 13 或更高系统，至少 5GB 内存。Adobe Fonts、字幕强化、关键帧、节拍检测和与桌面版接续剪辑等功能将在后续更新中加入。
title_en: Adobe Premiere Mobile Officially Launches on Android
content_en:
Adobe has officially launched the mobile version of Premiere on Android. The app offers its core editing features for free, completely free of advertisements and export watermarks.

The mobile editor supports multi-track timelines, frame-accurate editing, one-tap voice enhancement, and up to 4K video export. It also integrates Adobe Firefly's generative AI capabilities, including Generative Fill, Image-to-Video, and Sound Effects generation. While basic features are free, users must pay for additional generative credits and cloud storage.

To run the app, devices must have Android 13 or higher and at least 5GB of RAM. Adobe has promised that highly anticipated features—such as Adobe Fonts, enhanced captions, keyframes, beat detection, and cross-platform syncing with the desktop version—will be introduced in future updates.

title_zh: 千问办公发布「企业上下文」与 QwenNote A2
content_zh:
千问办公 9 月 22 日发布面向企业的「企业上下文」产品，将企业多年积累的数据压缩、结构化，再按具体任务为 Agent 组装相关信息。上下文会随业务变化更新，内置模型用于降低数据压缩和处理时的 Token 消耗。

企业还可基于千问办公和钉钉创建数字员工，为其配置所属部门、岗位职责、授权范围和生命周期。新的协作空间能关联群聊、文档和知识库，让员工与 Agent、Agent 之间共同分工，执行记录和产出统一留存在协作空间中。

同时发布的 QwenNote A2 是首款 QwenNote 硬件，支持语音转写和语音调用千问办公执行任务。官方称，转写完成后只保留文字和纪要，不保留原始音频。新上线的安全中心则集中管理 Agent 的数据访问、工具调用和任务执行，支持沙箱边界、高风险操作审批与全程审计。
title_en: Qwen Office Unveils "Enterprise Context" and QwenNote A2 Hardware
content_en:
Qwen Office has launched "Enterprise Context," a new product designed to compress and structure years of accumulated corporate data, dynamically assembling relevant information for AI agents based on specific tasks. The system updates in real-time with business changes and utilizes built-in models to minimize token consumption during data processing.

Through Qwen Office and DingTalk, enterprises can now deploy digital employees with customizable roles, departments, authorization limits, and lifecycles. A new collaborative workspace integrates group chats, documents, and knowledge bases, enabling seamless collaboration between human employees and AI agents, as well as agent-to-agent coordination.

Alongside the software updates, Qwen Office debuted QwenNote A2, its first hardware device. The tool supports voice transcription and voice-activated tasks, automatically deleting original audio files post-transcription to protect privacy. Additionally, a new Security Center has been introduced to manage data access, tool usage, and task execution with sandboxing, high-risk approval workflows, and comprehensive auditing.

title_zh: rabbit 发布 OS3，不用 R1 硬件也能使用
content_zh:
rabbit 推出独立的智能体操作系统 OS3，用户可以直接通过浏览器使用，不需要购买 R1 硬件。R1 仅是 OS3 的其中一个语音入口，网页和 Telegram 也能连接同一账户下的记忆与上下文。

OS3 采用自带 API Key 的方式，用户可选择支持的模型提供商。在电脑上安装 rabbit agent 后，OS3 能使用本地文件、终端工具和桌面应用，一个任务也可以协调多台电脑。官方还宣布，原先独立提供的 rabbit intern 已并入 OS3 体系。

OS3 目前免费开放，模型调用费用由用户直接支付给对应提供商。rabbit 将它标记为技术预览版，明确提醒不应用于生产、企业、受监管、安全关键或无人值守场景。
title_en: Rabbit Launches OS3: No R1 Hardware Required
content_en:
AI startup Rabbit has released OS3, an independent agent operating system that users can access directly through a web browser without needing the company's proprietary R1 hardware. The R1 device now serves merely as one of several voice entry points, alongside web and Telegram interfaces that connect to the same user account, memory, and context.

OS3 operates on a "bring your own API key" model, allowing users to select their preferred AI model providers and pay them directly for token usage. By installing the Rabbit Agent on a computer, OS3 can access local files, terminal tools, and desktop applications, even coordinating tasks across multiple computers. The company also announced that its previously standalone "rabbit intern" tool has been integrated into the OS3 ecosystem.

Currently available as a free technical preview, Rabbit explicitly warns that OS3 should not be used for production, enterprise, regulated, safety-critical, or unattended scenarios.

title_zh: 星巴克与陕西历史博物馆联名，西安上线限定饮品与唐风巡礼
content_zh:
星巴克携手陕西历史博物馆推出大唐文化巡礼。联名系列以馆藏唐代鸳鸯莲瓣纹金碗为灵感，全国星巴克门店发售金碗款礼盒、马克杯、纯钛系列和主题熊周边等商品。

西安臻选门店同期推出两款限定饮品：「永宁碧澜」以臻选浓缩搭配抹茶奶泡，「青漾长安」则是抹茶与香草拿铁，顶部用抹茶粉呈现「长安」字样。

线下巡礼还包括一辆串联西安文旅地标的唐风主题观光巴士，以及曲江大悦城臻选店、西安 SKP 中厅臻选店、钟楼臻选店、南大街中大国际臻选店和大唐芙蓉园南门店五个主题点位。特定时段的巴士上将加入「李白诗游长安」互动演绎，各门店还设有集章活动。
title_en: Starbucks Partners with Shaanxi History Museum for Tang Dynasty-Themed Campaign in Xi'an
content_en:
Starbucks has partnered with the Shaanxi History Museum to launch a Tang Dynasty cultural campaign. Inspired by the museum's famous Tang Dynasty gold bowl decorated with mandarin ducks and lotus petals, Starbucks is releasing a nationwide collection of themed merchandise, including gift boxes, mugs, titanium cups, and Bearista accessories.

In Xi'an, Starbucks Reserve stores have introduced two exclusive drinks: "Yongning Bilan," which pairs Reserve espresso with matcha cold foam, and "Qingyang Chang'an," a matcha and vanilla latte topped with the word "Chang'an" dusted in matcha powder.

The collaboration also features an offline cultural tour, highlighted by a Tang Dynasty-themed sightseeing bus connecting Xi'an's historic landmarks and five designated Reserve stores. During select hours, the bus will host interactive poetry performances, and participating stores will offer stamp-collecting activities for visitors.

title_zh: LISA 联名 DualSense 手柄 10 月 30 日发售
content_zh:
PlayStation 宣布将于 10 月 30 日发售 DualSense 无线控制器 LISA 限量版，并于 10 月 2 日开放预购。该款手柄将通过 PlayStation 直销渠道和全球参与活动的零售商限量发售，建议零售价为 84.99 美元。

手柄的触摸板印有 LISA 的标志性刘海和眼睛图案，并加入星星、「LL」签名和珍珠色渐变涂装。同日上市的还有 LISA x PlayStation 服饰、帽子、手柄包和钥匙扣等周边；LISA 的新 EP《Press Play》将提前一周于 10 月 23 日发行。
title_en: PlayStation to Release Limited-Edition LISA DualSense Controller on October 30
content_en:
PlayStation has announced a limited-edition DualSense wireless controller in collaboration with global music icon LISA, set to launch on October 30. Pre-orders will open on October 2 through PlayStation Direct and select global retailers, with a suggested retail price of $84.99.

The controller's touchpad features LISA's signature bangs and eyes, complemented by stars, an "LL" signature, and a pearlescent gradient finish.

In addition to the controller, a range of LISA x PlayStation merchandise—including apparel, hats, controller cases, and keychains—will launch on the same day. This release follows the debut of LISA's new EP, *Press Play*, which is scheduled to drop a week earlier on October 23.

title_zh: Netflix 与大英图书馆推出影视创作对谈系列
content_zh:
Netflix 与大英图书馆建立合作，将在伦敦举办一系列面向公众的影视创作对谈，围绕文学改编、表演和剧集开发展开。

首场活动与 Netflix 新剧《伊甸之东》相关，佛罗伦斯·珀、编剧 Zoe Kazan 等主创参与。该剧改编自约翰·斯坦贝克的同名小说，共 7 集，将于 10 月 1 日上线 Netflix；Kazan 同时担任编剧和执行制片人。
title_en: Netflix Partners with British Library for Creative Industry Talk Series
content_en:
Netflix has partnered with the British Library to launch a series of public panel discussions in London. The events will focus on screenwriting, acting, and series development, with a particular emphasis on literary adaptations.

The inaugural event will center on Netflix's upcoming limited series *East of Eden*, featuring key creatives including star Florence Pugh and writer-executive producer Zoe Kazan.

Adapted from John Steinbeck's classic novel, the seven-episode series is scheduled to premiere on Netflix on October 1.

title_zh: 《夜魔侠：重生》将在第 3 季完结
content_zh:
据 Deadline 报道，Marvel 剧集《夜魔侠：重生》将在第 3 季结束，新一季预计于 2027 年在 Disney+ 上线。

该系列从 Netflix 时期的 3 季，到 Disney+ 重启后的 3 季，将共经历 6 季内容。Charlie Cox 继续饰演 Matt Murdock，Vincent D’Onofrio 回归饰演 Kingpin；第 3 季的具体剧情和上线日期尚未公布。
title_en: Marvel's 'Daredevil: Born Again' to Conclude with Season 3 on Disney+
content_en:
Marvel's upcoming series *Daredevil: Born Again* is set to conclude with its third season, which is expected to premiere on Disney+ in 2027, according to a report by Deadline.

With this final installment, the overall Daredevil saga will span six seasons in total, split evenly between its original run on Netflix and its revival on Disney+.

Charlie Cox will continue to star as Matt Murdock, alongside Vincent D’Onofrio returning as the iconic villain Kingpin. Specific plot details and an exact release date for the third season have not yet been disclosed.

title_zh: 汤姆·克鲁斯：AI 会进入电影，但观众仍想看真实的人与事
content_zh:
汤姆·克鲁斯在英国电影和电视艺术学院的「Life in Pictures」活动上公开发言，回应电影行业围绕 AI 、演员与幕后岗位的争议。他认为 AI 会到来，也会被使用，但创作者仍应持续拍摄真实的人、表演和环境，因为观众依然想要看到「真实的事物」。

这段发言发生在伦敦的小型公开对谈中。克鲁斯用约 6 分钟谈人工智能，现场听众主要是 BAFTA 会员和电影从业者。他把话题从演员扩展到幕后工种，称不希望失去那些长期投入电影制作的工艺人员。

他把自己的判断放在电影史中：电影一直吸收新技术，创作者可以学习工具，但工具不应削弱人在现场的判断、协作和表演。他接受技术会继续进入制作流程，同时将摄影机前后的人视为电影制作主体。

克鲁斯还鼓励年轻电影人不要因技术变化而停止创作，继续练习叙事、表演和制作。他说的「继续创作」也是对这一立场的具体补充：可以吸收 AI，但不要把人的经验从作品中移除。
title_en: Tom Cruise on AI in Film: Audiences Still Crave the 'Real Thing'
content_en:
During a "Life in Pictures" event hosted by the British Academy of Film and Television Arts (BAFTA) in London, Tom Cruise addressed the ongoing industry debate surrounding artificial intelligence. While acknowledging that AI is inevitable and will be integrated into filmmaking, Cruise emphasized that creators must continue to focus on real people, authentic performances, and physical environments, asserting that audiences ultimately still want to see "the real thing."

Speaking to an audience of BAFTA members and industry professionals, Cruise expanded the conversation beyond actors to include behind-the-scenes crew members. He expressed a strong desire to protect the livelihoods and crafts of long-term production crew. Drawing from film history, Cruise noted that cinema has always adapted to new technologies. He argued that while filmmakers should learn to use these new tools, technology should never overshadow human judgment, collaboration, and on-set performance.

Cruise concluded by encouraging the next generation of filmmakers not to let technological shifts deter them. He urged young creators to keep honing their skills in storytelling, acting, and production, advising them to embrace AI as a tool without stripping the essential human experience from their work.
